definition.en: A break or disruption in the continuity of a bone.
definition.ps: دا د طبي زده کړې لنډه تشریح ده: A break or disruption in the continuity of a bone.
definition.fa: خلاصه آموزشی: A break or disruption in the continuity of a bone.

explanation.en: Fractures range from small cracks to complete breaks and are evaluated according to location, pattern, alignment, and surrounding tissue injury.
explanation.ps: د دې اصطلاح مهم معلومات د زده کړې لپاره په ساده ډول وړاندې کېږي.
explanation.fa: اطلاعات اصلی این اصطلاح برای مطالعه به شکل ساده ارائه می‌شود.

source: U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM) MeSH — educational summary
